title: Battle of Aghaiani
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Aghaiani", at revision 1370921657, opens: "The Battle of Aghaiani was a battle fought in 1625 between the armies of Safavid Iran and the Kingdom of Kakheti." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870223, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1625 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
